errors.what: The folded map is drawn as three separate, identical sheets stacked on top of each other. Each one has its own closed rim and zigzag edge, and no fold joins one layer to the next, so paper could not fold this way.

cards.fix: a single folded paper map with accordion folds, each panel joined to the next by a visible crease, the top panel showing the treasure path and red X

errors.where: chair frame under the armrests and seat
errors.what: The tubes are tangled. The armrest tubes curve down and disappear into the seat fabric without meeting the legs, and the crossed legs don't form a clear pair of X-frames joined by the pivot, so you can't tell how the chair stands or folds.

cards.fix: folding camp chair with two clear X-shaped leg frames joined by a pivot bolt, armrest posts running straight down into the leg frame, and four feet on the floor

errors.where: lowest sail on the main mast
errors.what: The lowest main sail hangs down past the deck rail and into the hull, where there is no room for it to fall.

cards.fix: main course sail ending clearly above the deck railing, with its lower corners tied off by ropes to the deck
